ideas.name: AI Video Crediting
ideas.problem: As AI video generation tools proliferate, there's a lack of standardization in crediting the specific AI models and versions used. This platform automates the process of identifying and embedding accurate credits for AI-generated videos, benefiting both creators and audiences.
ideas.monetization: API access for video platforms and creators (tiered pricing based on volume) and a marketplace for AI model usage analytics.

ideas.monetization: Subscription-based access to premium content and community features ($19.99/month).

ideas.name: Hand-Drawn QR Designer
ideas.problem: Small businesses and indie creators want unique branding elements that stand out from generic QR codes. This tool allows users to design visually appealing, custom hand-drawn style QR codes that reflect their brand identity.
ideas.monetization: One-time purchase for design pack licenses ($15-$50 depending on features) and a subscription for unlimited generation and advanced customization ($9.99/month).

ideas.name: LLM Training Playground
ideas.problem: Individuals and small teams are interested in training their own LLMs but lack an accessible and cost-effective platform to experiment with diverse datasets and architectures. This webapp provides a simplified interface for custom LLM training and evaluation.
ideas.monetization: Pay-as-you-go for compute resources and tiered subscription plans for larger training runs and access to pre-trained model bases ($0.05/hour compute + optional $49/month for advanced features).
